environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith directly on port 8080, exposed via a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with a public DNS record. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting, no WAF, no CloudFront. The application is accessed directly at http://nlb-legacy-app-abc123.elb.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:8080/
